About

Learning by building. Growing through real work.

I am a Computer Science graduate and Junior PHP Developer based in Rawalpindi, Pakistan. I support PHP/MySQL web applications and have practical knowledge of Laravel, HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, JavaScript, jQuery and AJAX. My work includes CRUD operations, SQL queries, RESTful API integration, JSON responses and backend/frontend debugging. I am keen to learn from experienced developers and contribute to reliable, maintainable web applications.

projects/rest-api-task-manager.html:
All projects

Practical learning project · ​

REST API Task Manager

Role: Learning project developer

​

A practical learning project for understanding REST API development and frontend integration using PHP, MySQL and JavaScript. It covers CRUD endpoints, JSON request/response handling, authentication flow, validation, search/filtering, pagination, Postman testing and JavaScript Fetch API integration.

What the project covers

  • CRUD endpoints using GET, POST, PUT/PATCH and DELETE
  • JSON request and response handling
  • Authentication flow and validation
  • Search / filtering and pagination
  • Postman endpoint testing
  • JavaScript Fetch API integration

Tech stack
